settings.heading: LOVE YOU FIRST
settings.body: You are seen. You are valued. You are enough. Exactly as you are. Your journey is yours. Don’t compare it. Honor it. This is your reminder to love what’s already within you. Wear it close.

settings.heading: Introducing LOVELACE’D
settings.body: Custom photo luggage tags, designed by you, printed by us. Upload your photo, pick your style, and we handle the rest. Every order is personally reviewed before it’s printed.

settings.heading: The Story
settings.body:
LOVELACE started with a name. My name. After years of building a brand around initials that never quite fit, I realized the answer was always there. LOVELACE. Easy to say. Easy to remember. And right in the middle of it, the word that matters most. Love.

This brand is built on one idea. You have to love yourself first. Not someday. Now. Like the oxygen mask on a plane, you secure yours before you help anyone else. That’s not selfish. That’s necessary.

Everything here is a reminder of that. The clothes you wear. The tags you carry. The way you move through the world. This is your reminder to love what’s already within you.
